test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The theme of the 6th International Day of Yoga-2020 was ________.

options.text: Yoga at Home and Yoga with Family
Be with Yoga, Be at Home!

solution:
The correct answer is __**Yoga at Home and Yoga with Family.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme of the **6th International Day **of** Yoga-2020** was **"Yoga at Home and Yoga with Family."**
 
• This theme was chosen in response to the** COVID-19 pandemic**, which made it difficult for people to gather in large groups for yoga events.
 
• The theme emphasized the **importance of practicing yoga** at home and with family members to **promote physical and mental health** during this challenging time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** ("Do Yoga at home") is similar to the actual theme, but it **doesn't **mention the importance of practicing with family members.
 
• **Option 2** ("Har Ghar Yog") translates to "Yoga in every home," which is a similar idea but **doesn't **explicitly mention practicing with family members.
 
• **Option 4 **("Be with Yoga, Be at Home!") is a catchy phrase, but it** doesn't **convey the same message as the actual theme.
 
• Hence, the** correct **option is option 3 - "Yoga at Home and Yoga with Family."
